2026-09-27.summary:
### Livestock & Animals
- Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
- Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
- Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
- Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.

### Structures
- Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-26.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
